note: IST hours when a scheduled run may post (cron wakes 3x/hour; the gate applies). 6/day, evening-weighted for Indian viewers, spaced to reduce self-competition/cannibalization. The dashboard chat agent can change this.
gap_note: Shorts cadence gate: a scheduled Shorts run posts only if the last Short/promo is >= min_gap_min old (long_story ignored). 150 min targets ~6 well-spaced posts/day to give each Short more room to get impressions.
